svg.title: Chip temperature and fan speed during a work session (simulated)
svg.desc: MacFanOptimizer (Smart): peaks at 85 °C; macOS default (emulated): peaks at 96 °C; Fixed 6000 rpm: peaks at 95 °C. Smart and macOS keep the fans off while idle; the fixed setting runs them at 6000 rpm throughout.
svg.text: Cooler under load, silent when idle
A work session in the thermal simulator calibrated on an M5 Pro MacBook Pro: idle, 8 min of heavy work (~75 W), idle
